# Escalation note: BMC-style format (reconstructed template, not an official BMC form)

Use this layout when drafting. Keep [brackets] for anything the data cannot fill.

```text
              BRIHANMUMBAI MUNICIPAL CORPORATION
  Office of the [Assistant Engineer / Executive Engineer] ([Department Name, e.g., Maintenance / SWD /
                                                  Roads])
                [Ward Name, e.g., N Ward] Office Building, [Address], Mumbai – [PIN Code]


Outward No.: [Dept/Ward/AE/____/2026-27]                                           Date: [DD/MM/YYYY]

To,
The [Executive Engineer / Deputy Chief Engineer / Chief Engineer] ([Department Name]),
[Zone / Central Office Address, e.g., Zone-VI / Engineering Hub, Worli],
Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation, Mumbai – [PIN Code].

                            SUBMISSION / ESCALATION NOTE

Sub:      Escalation and request for higher-level intervention / administrative approval for the
          work of "[Full Name of Work as per Tender]" (SAP Work Order / P.O. No.
          [XXXXXXXXXX]).
Ref:      1. Work Order / P.O. No. [WO/PO No.] dated [DD/MM/YYYY] issued to M/s. [Contractor
             Name].
          2. Site Inspection Report / J.E. Note dated [DD/MM/YYYY].
          3. Notice(s) issued to Contractor vide No. [Notice No.] dated [DD/MM/YYYY].

Respected Sir / Madam,

With reference to the subject cited above, the work of "[Name of Work]" at [Location / Beat No.] in
[Ward Name] was awarded to M/s. [Contractor Name]. The brief contractual particulars of the work
are summarized below for kind perusal:

 SAP Work Order / P.O. No. &        [XXXXXXXXXX] dated [DD/MM/YYYY]
 Date

 Original Contract Cost             Rs. [Amount]/- (including/excluding GST)

 Stipulated Completion Period       [X] Months/Days (Start: [DD/MM/YYYY] | Due End: [DD/MM/
                                    YYYY])

 Physical Progress & Site-in-       [XX]% completed | J.E.: [Name of J.E.] / S.E.: [Name of S.E.]
 Charge

Grounds for Escalation (Tick / Retain Applicable):
1. Contractor Delay / Non-Performance: Despite repeated site instructions and written notices (Ref.
   3), the contractor has failed to mobilize adequate manpower/machinery, resulting in slow progress
   and risk of missing the stipulated deadline.
2. Extra / Excess Item & Financial Variation: Due to unforeseen site conditions ([specify, e.g.,
   underground utilities / hard rock / structural variation]), quantities have exceeded the sanctioned
   BOQ / extra items are required, necessitating approval beyond ward-level financial delegation.
3. Inter-Departmental / Utility Hindrance: Execution is held up due to pending NOC / shifting of
   utilities belonging to [BEST / Tata Power / Mahanagar Gas / Traffic Police / SWD / HE Dept.]
   requiring higher-level coordination.
4. Time Extension / Penalty / Termination Action: Proposal for [Extension of Time (EOT) / Levy of
   Liquidated Damages / Risk & Cost Action / Contract Termination] as per General Conditions of
   Contract (GCC) Clause [Clause No.].

Action Requested from Higher Authority:
In view of the above facts and to ensure timely completion of public infrastructure work without further
cost or time overrun, the matter is escalated to your office for kind perusal, necessary directions, and
approval of [specify exact approval sought, e.g., administrative sanction for variation / show-cause
hearing / inter-departmental intervention].

Submitted for kind consideration and further orders, please.

                                                                             Yours faithfully,



                                                                                  Sd/-
                                                                     [Name of Forwarding Officer]
                                                                    [Junior Engineer / Sub-Engineer /
                                                                           Assistant Engineer]
                                                                  ([Department Name]), [Ward Name]
                                                                                  Ward
                                                                 Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation


Encl.: (1) Copy of Work Order (2) Hindrance Register Extract (3) Notices Issued (4) Site Photographs
Copy submitted for information to:
1. Assistant Commissioner ([Ward Name] Ward) — for kind information.
2. Sub-Engineer / Assistant Engineer ([Section/Dept.]) — for record and follow-up.
3. Office Copy / Work Order Master File.

```
